notes.title: A little demo of a little eco-gem game
notes.content:
Hello, wonderful people! 
As you've probably noticed, we decided to share a little demo of Sorted! so you could check your waste sorting skills. Play it now while Steam Next Fest lasts, and follow the link at the end of the demo to share your feedback with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957265/8c055f520db9382c54eb5c512ad93a5732297a8e.jpg

Why should you play Sorted!?

This probably won't come as a surprise to you, but our planet is in real danger because of the amount of litter lying around, or simply being thrown into the wrong bins. History has seen great fires caused by a single piece of glass left of a broken bottle in the forest. Marine animals experience awful physical trauma because of plastic bags wrapping around their necks when they are young and growing into them as time goes on. Each of us can see lots of waste lying around our cities and villages because there is always this one person throwing thrash in the middle of the street who says that this bin standing about 15 meters further is too far.
We can be a significant change! But first, we need to learn to sort waste properly.

That's why we've decided to make that little game. We want to educate, and we want to raise awareness. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957265/08fc9886795fb3da3cd2f8ecc560d8ff9bbe63d6.jpg

It's so simple to recycle! You just need to know a few rules.

Stream the game on your Twitch channels, publish gameplay on Youtube, and help us teach gamers how to help our planet! Or simply come and enjoy yourself while trying to reach the highest score! In the demo, you can also try the co-op mode and 1 vs 1!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42957265/aca8e6faeb559216ba7fca05367829b303085bd1.jpg

Don't miss your chance and put the waste in the right place before the Steam Next Fest ends on February 13th.

Earth Loves You!
Sorted! team
